Composer rings show 5h/7d plan windows or metere"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"d balance for the current session model. / 把线上模型列表写进设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"dsh-model-sync"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Writes each provider's live model list into DeepSeek Harness settings. Plan routes read 5h and 7d windows, metered routes read the balance le"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ft since the last top-up. With windows and a top-up pack together, the icon draws the windows and ke"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"eps the pack in the hover card."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It takes two settings pages, one for fetching model ids per provider and one for per-model usage. **"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"Model Sync** (sync-arrow icon) writes new model ids from each provider into settings. **Usage** list"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"s plan windows, cumulative counts, and API balance. Resets show as countdowns such as `2d 3h left`. "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"The 5h and 7d windows each get their own row. The plugin is listed in the awe"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"some-dsh-plugin market list."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The package ships a cordis.patch.yml bundle patch (`dsh.bundle`) and declares `dsh.client.immediatel"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"y: true`, so it takes effect on install with no manual config."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Model Sync"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. **Settings → Model Sync**.
2. **Refresh** if the list is empty.
3. Each card lists the provider i"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"d, `baseURL`, and model chips. A blue outline marks ids not in settings yet. **Apply N new models** "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"writes them to `llm-pi-ai.providers.<id>.models`.
4. The collapsed **Enable plugins** block toggles "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"this plugin and the optional `sub-model-access`, writing the disabled flag in cordis.patch.yml. Take"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"d the optional `sub-model-access`, writing the disabled flag in cordis.patch.yml. Takes effect live."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"MiniMax, Kimi Coding, and OpenAI Codex have no OpenAI `/models` endpoint. The plugin uses the known "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"i Coding, and OpenAI Codex have no OpenAI `/models` endpoint. The plugin uses the known catalog ids."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Usage"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. **Settings → Usage**.
2. Each provider lists its 5-hour and 7-day windows, one row each, with rem"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"aining percent, vendor cumulative counts, a reset countdown, and a colored bar.
3. Metered rows show"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" `current / baseline`. The first sample becomes the baseline. To count spend from before the plugin "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"was enabled, click **Use current balance as baseline**. The balance row also records when the baseli"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ne was set.
4. The page auto-refreshes every 60 seconds. **Refresh** pulls immediately."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Composer rings"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. Pick a model as usual.
2. The ring is right of the model name and left of the context meter. It f"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ollows the session model and switches with it.
3. Hover the ring for a detail card titled `provider "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"/ model` for this session. Each window gets a row with remaining percent and reset countdown, for ex"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ample `5 hours    left 100% · 2h 15m left`.
4. Other providers stay on the Usage page."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Quota sources"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Provider | Icon | Source |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `openai-codex` | 5h / 7d | `chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage` |
| `kimi-coding` | 5h / 7d, top-u"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"p pack in the hover card | `api.kimi.com/coding/v1/usages` |
| `zai` | 5h / 7d | `api.z.ai/api/monit"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"or/usage/quota/limit` |
| `minimax-cn` | 5h / 7d | `api.minimaxi.com/v1/api/openplatform/coding_plan"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"/remains` |
| `xai` | 7d | grok.com gRPC-web, ported from CC Switch |
| `deepseek-official` | balanc"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"e vs last top-up | `api.deepseek.com/user/balance` |
| `xiaomi` | no data | no public plan API |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The DeepSeek metered baseline lives in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/model-sync.baseline.json`. A re"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ading above the stored baseline counts as a top-up and resets the baseline."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| `profile` | `web` | Which `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>` to read and write |
| `pollMs` | `60000` | P"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"oll interval parameter, minimum `5000`. - Quota calls use credentials already stored in DSH. The p"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"lugin keeps no keys of its own.
- Ring placement is bound to DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 composer class names.
